issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הֲלֹא אָמַרְתִּי לֹא תַשְׁלֶה אֹתִי' means 'Did I not say, Do not mislead me?' (i.e., 'Do not deceive me' or 'Do not mock me'). The Vietnamese 'Tôi chẳng nói: Đừng làm tôi buồn khổ sao?' renders 'תַשְׁלֶה' as 'làm tôi buồn khổ' (make me sad/afflict me), which changes the meaning from 'deceive/mock/mislead' to 'cause grief/suffering'. This is a substantive semantic shift in the verb's meaning.
